name: unifae-platform
description: UNIFAE — API (NestJS) + Management (Vue). Um comando para desenvolver.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,mobile,sync -c cyan,magenta,green,yellow "npm run start:dev --prefix unifae-api" "node scripts/wait-for-api.mjs && npm run dev --prefix unifae-management -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5173" "npm run start --prefix unifae-app-jorney-evidence" "node scripts/git-sync.mjs"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix unifae-api && npm run build --prefix unifae-management
